$comment: Divergences that have been reviewed and approved. The runner drops any finding that matches one of these, so a settled decision never comes back as a new finding. Keep the reason and the approver: an exception without them is indistinguishable from a bug someone got tired of.

exceptions.reason: Third-party widget ships its own focus ring. Vendor will not expose it; replacing the widget is scheduled, not urgent.
Inline control inside a text row; the WCAG 2.5.8 inline exception applies.
